blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—San Beda’s win over Jose Rizal University on Friday in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament was overshadowed by a freak accident involving Jimmy Reyes. During a rebound play, Reyes collided with teammate JC Bonzalida at the 7:11 mark in the fourth quarter. Reyes’ head then struck the floor, leaving him down as medical personnel attended to him. He was eventually stretchered off the court, and the Red Lions managed to escape with a 75-71 win.
